summary: Configured node1, node2, node3 as a 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster (RHEL9, mariadb-server-galera 10.5.29, rsync SST). Firewalld ports 3306/4567(tcp+udp)/4568/4444 opened on all nodes; SELinux mysqld_port_t already covered them. node1 bootstrapped via galera_new_cluster; node2 and node3 joined via systemctl enable --now mariadb. Verified writes through any member are visible on the others. Stopped node3 to prove the cluster stays available (quorum 2/3, Primary, write succeeded); restarted node3 and confirmed automatic IST resync (Synced, size 3) including the row written while it was down. Then ran the mandatory one-node-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes via systemctl reboot, confirming a changed /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id and full Galera recovery (size 3, Primary, Synced, data intact) after each restart before proceeding to the next node.
actions_performed: Installed mariadb-server, mariadb-server-galera, galera, rsync on all 3 nodes
Added /etc/hosts entries and opened firewalld ports 3306,4567/tcp+udp,4568,4444 on all nodes
Verified SELinux mysqld_port_t already covers Galera ports
Deployed /etc/my.cnf.d/galera.cnf on each node with wsrep_cluster_address listing all 3 IPs and unique wsrep_node_name/address
Bootstrapped node1 via galera_new_cluster, enabled mariadb service
Joined node2 and node3 via systemctl enable --now mariadb
Created appuser with a generated password (kept out of transcript by reading it from local files rather than echoing it) for TCP write testing
Verified cross-node write replication: wrote via node1 and node2 TCP endpoints, read identical rows back on node1/node2/node3
Stopped node3 mariadb; confirmed node1/node2 stayed Primary at cluster size 2 and accepted a write
Started node3 mariadb; confirmed automatic IST resync to Synced/size 3 including the write made while it was down
Captured pre-restart boot_id and cluster health baseline on all 3 nodes
Restarted node1 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and full cluster recovery (size 3, Synced, data intact) before proceeding
Restarted node2 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and full cluster recovery (size 3, Synced, data intact) before proceeding
Restarted node3 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and full cluster recovery (size 3, Synced, data intact)
Final cluster-wide check confirming wsrep_cluster_size=3, Primary, Synced, all incoming addresses present

evidence.requirement: 3-member Galera cluster formed, writes through any member visible on others
evidence.summary: All three nodes report wsrep_cluster_size=3, Primary, Synced; a write via node1's TCP endpoint and a write via node2's TCP endpoint are both visible when queried locally on node1, node2, and node3.

evidence.requirement: Cluster stays available when one member is unavailable
evidence.summary: node3's mariadb was stopped; node1 and node2 remained wsrep_cluster_status=Primary at size 2 and node1 successfully accepted a new write while node3 was down.

evidence.requirement: Unavailable member resynchronizes automatically on return
evidence.summary: After restarting mariadb on node3, it rejoined automatically reaching wsrep_local_state_comment=Synced and wsrep_cluster_size=3, and its local query returned the row written while it was down, proving automatic IST resync.

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 4999270d... captured with cluster Synced; systemctl reboot acknowledged before disconnect; post-restart boot_id a4a50f8f... (changed) and mariadb active with cluster size 3, Synced, data intact.

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 55595e92... captured with cluster Synced; systemctl reboot acknowledged before disconnect; post-restart boot_id b3818870... (changed) and mariadb active with cluster size 3, Synced, data intact.

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 31949c21... captured with cluster Synced; systemctl reboot acknowledged before disconnect; post-restart boot_id bdc22efe... (changed) and mariadb active with cluster size 3, Synced, data intact.
firewalld opened 3306/4567(tcp+udp)/4568/4444 on all three nodes; SELinux semanage confirmed mysqld_port_t already includes these ports (supporting evidence, not restart proof).
